title: Set up the equation
text: Newton's second law gives $$m v'=m g-k v$$, or $$v'+\frac{k}{m} v=g$$, with $$v(0)=0$$.

title: Solve
text: The integrating factor is $$e^{\frac{k t}{m}}$$. This gives $$v=\frac{g m}{k}+C e^{\left(-\frac{k t}{m}\right)}$$, and $$v(0)=0$$ gives $$C=\frac{-g m}{k}$$. So $$v=\frac{g m}{k} \left(1-e^{\left(-\frac{k t}{m}\right)}\right)$$.
